title: Graduate Development Program
location: Australia-wide offices including Mildura VIC; Adelaide head office
content_text: Tonkin Graduate Development Program (https://www.tonkin.com.au/graduate-development-program). Two-year program for recent graduates who studied civil engineering, structural engineering, drafting, spatial or environmental science. Year 1 structured workshops; year 2 customised learning. Offices include Mildura VIC and Adelaide head office. Contact Saumya Sharma, Talent Acquisition Consultant, mailto:Saumya.Sharma@tonkin.com.au.
apply_instructions: Email Saumya.Sharma@tonkin.com.au (Talent Acquisition Consultant) about the Graduate Development Program; published mailto on the graduate program page.
